newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Weitnauer wins tender to run Tunisian free shops.
newsitem.headline: Weitnauer wins tender to run Tunisian free shops.

text.p: Tunisia has awarded Swiss firm Weitnauer a contract to run all tax-free shops at the country's six airports as part of its privatisation programme, official sources said on Tuesday.
They told Reuters that from July 1st Weitnauer would take over the management of the free shops previously run by Office des Ports Aeriens de Tunisie (OPAT).
OPAT, which is the state's agency for running airports, had launched the tender last July. The concession won by Weitnauer was for eight years, the sources said.
The six airports are those of Tunis-Carthage, Monastir-Bourguiba, Djerba-Zarzis, Sfax-Thyna, Tozeur-Nefta, and Tabarka-7 Novembre.
Passengers traffic in Tunisian airports reached about seven million passengers in 1995.
